integrity: All stated matrices, unit determinants, complete automorphism actions, and exact Morse cancellations derive from the embedded standalone finite verifier; no third-party certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The integral module theorem is for the ordinary independence complex of Q4 only; no equivariant homotopy decomposition or general hypercube extension is claimed. Earlier work already established the nonequivariant rank seven and existence of crosspolytopal cycles. Bibliographic completeness cannot be proved.
title: Eight minimum-support octahedral spheres give the integral hyperoctahedral module of the four-cube independence complex
